verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional documents registrable HTTP POST webhooks for message events covering send, delivered, open, click, hard/soft bounce, spam, unsub and reject, with test-and-debug guidance (docs-18, docs-28, docs-29). The Marketing API separately offers webhooks for subscription and campaign-sending events, with a documented 'Verifying webhook signatures' section, though they require Standard or Premium plans (docs-19, docs-31, docs-20). missing for 10: signature verification evidenced only for Marketing webhooks rather than the Transactional engagement-event webhooks, no detailed payload schema in evidence, opens and clicks only for Transactional sends rather than Marketing campaigns, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
